Chapter: Preliminary
1.1 Legal Basis
These Rules and Regulations are issued as per Section 90 to
128 of the Information, Communications and Media Act of
Bhutan 2018 (“the Act”) by the Bhutan InfoComm and Media
Authority (“the Authority”) for ensuring fair and efficient
regulation of the cable television industry.
1.2 Title and Commencement
These Rules and Regulations shall be called as Rules and
Regulations for the Operation of Cable Television Service and
shall come into force on the 1st day of July, 2019 corresponding
to the 29th day of fourth month of the Bhutanese Earth Female
Pig Year.
1.3 Scope of Application
These Rules and Regulations shall apply for operation of Cable
Television services within the Kingdom of Bhutan and shall be
read in conjunction with all other existing codes of practice and
Rules established by the Authority.
1.4 Amendments
Amendment to these Rules and Regulations shall be made
according to the needs and changes in national priorities, policies
and industry trends. The amendment of these Rules and
Regulations by way of addition, variation or repeal may be
effected by the Authority as and when required.
1 | Pa ge

1.5 Repeal
With the commencement of these Rules and Regulations, the
Rule for the operation of cable television service 2017 are
repealed
1.6 Interpretation
The power to interpret these Rules and Regulations shall vest
with the Authority who may issue such instructions as may be
necessary to give effect to and implement the provisions of these
Rules and Regulations.
1.7 Rules of Construction
In these Rules and Regulations, unless the context indicates
otherwise, the masculine gender shall include the feminine
gender and the singular shall include the plural and vice versa.
1.8 Definition
In addition to the following terms, or unless the context requires
otherwise, the words and terms used in these Rules and
Regulations shall have the same meaning as assigned in the Act.
Alternative Dispute Resolution Centre means the Bhutan
Alternative Dispute Resolution Centre established as per
Alternative Dispute Resolution Act 2013.
Authority means the Bhutan InfoComm and Media Authority as
established under the provision of the Act.
Area of Operation means the designated area as approved by
the Authority.
2 | Pa ge

Cable Television Service means the distribution of programmes
produced by television broadcasters through cable/wireless
system.
Cable Television System means facility consisting of a set of
closed transmission paths and associated signal generation,
control and distribution equipment designed to provide cable
television service for reception by multiple subscribers within a
community.
Channel means a set of frequencies used for transmission of a
programme.
Control Room means an operations center which will serve as a
central space where a physical facility or physically dispersed
service can be monitored and controlled before being distributed
to the customers.
Local Administration means Dzongkhag, Thromde, Drungkhag
or Geog Administration.
Multi Service Operator (MSO) means a television Content
Provider, who will acquire foreign television content, re-process
and then distribute to the Local Cable Operators. It will be a
whole seller and national distributor of television content.
Nearest Distribution Point means the existing equipment from
where the cable television service can be extended and
distributed to the subscribers;
Pay Channel means a TV channel/channels for which fees are
charged by the broadcaster for its retransmission.
3 | Pa ge

Subscriber means a person, firm, corporation, or any other
entity who receives the cable television service from a licensed
cable operator.
Trunk Cables means the bundled wires, cables, or fiber optic
used to take television programs from one location to another
only and not for distribution to any subscriber.
4 | Pa ge

Chapter 2: Licensing Procedure
2.1 General Conditions
2.1.1Any person who intends to establish, maintain or operate
Cable television service shall acquire a valid license from
the Authority.
2.1.2An individual shall not be granted more than one Cable
television service license.
2.1.3 All licenses granted under these Rules and Regulations are
non-exclusive. However, the Authority shall determine the
requirement of additional licenses in the same area of
operation.
2.1.4The license for operation of CATV service shall exclusively
be for distribution of cable television programmes. The
licensee shall not have the right to distribute its own
content.
2.1.5The licensee shall not lease the license to any other person.
2.1.6Sharing of control rooms by licensees shall only be
permitted within the same Dzongkhag.
2.1.7 In the event, if a licensee wishes to share the control room,
then the proposal shall be submitted as per the Guidelines
issued by the Authority.
2.2 Application Procedure
2.2.1The application shall be submitted to the Authority in the
form prescribed under Annexure A of this Rules and
Regulations.
5 | Pa ge

2.2.2The Authority shall review the application and shall intimate
the decision in writing to the applicant within seven (7)
working days.
2.2.3The fee for the operation of Cable Television system shall be
applicable as prescribed in Schedule IV of this Rules and
Regulations.
2.2.4The Authority shall issue in-principle approval for
establishment of CATV system before issuance of CATV
operational license. The establishment of CATV system
shall be completed on or before one hundred and eighty
(180) days from the date of issuance of the in-principle
approval.
2.2.5In the event the applicant fails to establish the Cable
television system within the stipulated time frame, the
Authority shall have the right to deny the issuance of the
CATV operational license.
2.2.6The applicant shall be issued with a CATV operational
license only after field verification by the Authority or an
authorised representative.
2.2.7 The applicant shall commence the CATV service only after
obtaining CATV operational license from the Authority.
2.3 Procedure for the issuance of recommendation by Local
Administration
When the application is received for establishment of
CATV system within its jurisdiction, the Local
Administration shall ensure to carry out the following
process and accordingly submits its recommendation to the
Authority.
6 | Pa ge

(a) Determine the requirement of such establishment
taking into consideration any existing cable operator,
if any, and
(b) Assessment of the impact of the proposal in their
respective communities.
2.4 Renewal of License
2.4.1The CATV operational licenses irrespective of the date of
issuance shall be valid till 30th of June and shall be renewed
annually within 1st to 31st of July.
2.4.2The application for the renewal of the licence shall be
submitted to the Authority as per the form prescribed in
Annexure D of this Rules and Regulations.
2.4.3 A penalty of Ngultrum fifty (Nu.50) per day shall be levied
for failing to renew the license within the stipulated time for
a maximum of ninety (90) days after which the license shall
be automatically cancelled.
2.5 Change of Ownership
Change in ownership of CATV operational license shall be
permissible only on approval of the Authority. Such request
shall be submitted to the Authority.
2.6 Area of operation
2.6.1 The CATV operational license is location specific and the
licensee shall strictly comply with the area of operation as
specified in the license.
2.6.2 If the licensee intends to extend his service beyond the
designated area of operation then a prior approval shall be
sought from the Authority.
7 | Pa ge

2.6.3 Extension in the area of operation shall be considered only
within the Dzongkhag subject to market feasibility and with
recommendation of the Local Administration.
8 | Pa ge

Chapter 3: Cable Television Services
3.1 Provision of Service
3.1.1The licensee shall ensure that the National broadcasting
service channels (BBS 1 and 2) are included in their channel
bouquet.
3.1.2 The licensee shall only distribute the television channels
approved by the Authority.
3.1.3Any value added services through the cable television
system shall be permissible only after obtaining prior
approval of the Authority.
3.1.4 The licensee may levy the one-time installation charges to
the subscribers as approved by the Authority. However, the
licensee shall not levy the installation fee if a new customer
occupies the same place without having to reconstruct the
connection.
3.2 Monitoring of Services
Besides the Authority, the Local Administration shall
monitor the content and quality of cable services provided
by the licensee within their jurisdiction.
3.3 Subscription to foreign Television channels
3.3.1The licensee shall subscribe its foreign channels from the
licensed Multi Service Operator (MSO). However, in the
absence of licensed MSO, the licensee may subscribe from
any legitimate service providers approved by the Authority.
3.3.2The list of channels and the copy of the agreements signed
with such service provider(s) shall be submitted to the
Authority.
9 | Pa ge

3.4 Tariff
3.4.1The Authority shall set the tariff ceiling for the cable
television services based on the change in technology and
market dynamics.
3.4.2The tariff for value added services, if approved by the
Authority, shall be unbundled from cable television
services.
3.5 Discontinuation of the Service
3.5.1In the event if the licensee decides to discontinue the Cable
television service, the Licensee shall inform the Authority,
three months in advance and shall continue to provide such
service until a formal approval is accorded.
3.5.2The application for discontinuation of service shall be
submitted in writing along with tax clearance from the
Department of Revenue and Customs.
3.6 Inspection of records
3.6.1The licensee shall maintain a record of operation and such
record shall be made available to the Authority as and when
required. The record shall include, but be not limited to,
subscriber details, number of channels, operation and
maintenance record and network detail.
3.6.2 The Authority shall have the right to inspect at any time
during normal business hours, all books & records.’
3.7 Service standards
3.7.1The licensee shall ensure to render consistent quality of
service with minimum interruption at all times.
3.7.2The licensee shall make adequate provisions for customer
care service and complaint handling. All complaints shall be
10 | Pa ge

recorded and maintained at least for a period of six (6)
months.
3.7.3The licensee shall draw and maintain a detail Service Level
Agreement (SLA) with its customer.
3.7.4All trunk cables shall be installed underground or placed in
common duct if provided by the Local Administration.
3.7.5Distribution of CATV services shall be executed with
minimum disruptions to the community as well as the
aestheticity of the local environment.
3.7.6 Any infrastructures that are not in use or do not have any
future requirements shall be removed by the licensee.
3.8 Safety
3.8.1The licensee shall install and maintain its cable television
system for ensuring all types of safety including prevention
of any damages, injury, or nuisance to the public or its
subscriber or its employees.
3.8.2All licensees shall follow Rules and Regulations on
Infrastructure Sharing and the Rules and Regulations on
Sharing of Electricity Poles by Commercial Cable
Television Operators.
3.8.3In the event of damages caused due to neglect of safety
provisions, the licensee shall bear the cost of repair,
replacement or compensation.
11 | Pa ge

Chapter 4: Compliance, Penalties and Appeal
4.1 Compliance
4.1.1In addition to these Rules and Regulations, the licensee shall
comply with relevant laws, codes, standards, orders,
directives, notifications and guidelines.
4.1.2The licensee shall permit any official of the Authority or an
authorized representative to enter into any premises that
may be used by the licensee in connection with cable TV
system for the purpose of verifying compliance with the
standards, lawful orders, instructions or requirements of the
Authority.
4.2 Penalties
4.2.1 The Authority shall, subject to the degree of violation,
impose the following penalties:
(i) Issue a written warning letter for the first violation.
(ii) Impose a penalty equivalent to a maximum of six (6)
months daily minimum wage depending on the gravity
of the offence for the second violation;
(iii)Suspend the operation of the establishment for a
period of two months or impose a penalty equivalent
to six (6) months daily minimum wage or both
depending on the gravity of the offence for third
violation;
(iv) The license shall be cancelled automatically upon the
fourth violation.
12 | Pa ge

(v) Notwithstanding the above provisions, if the violation
is proven to be severe, the Authority may impose a
penalty up to one (1) year daily minimum wage or
suspend or cancel the licence.
(vi) In the event, if the licence is cancelled, the defaulter
shall not be eligible for the licence for a period of
three (3) years.
4.3 Appeal
4.3.1If aggrieved by the decision of the Authority, the licensee
may appeal against such decision to the Alternative Dispute
Resolution Centre within ten (10) days of the receipt of the
information of such decisions as per section 67 of the Act.
4.3.2 While appealing against the decision of the Authority, the
Licensee shall bear all the expenses incurred by Authority
including registration fee payable to the Alternative Dispute
Resolution Centre.
4.4 Indemnification
4.4.1 Licensee shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the
Authority and its officials, agents, attorneys and
representatives against any and all costs, damages,
expenses, claims, suits, actions, liabilities and judgments for
damages, including but not limited to, expenses for legal
fees, whether suit be brought or not, and disbursements and
liabilities incurred or assumed by the Authority in
connection with:
(i) damage to persons or property, in any way
arising out of or through the acts or omissions by
the Licensee, its officials, agents, attorneys,
representatives or employees;
13 | Pa ge

(ii) requests for relief arising out of any Licensee’s
action or inaction which results in a claim for
invasion of the right of privacy; for defamation
of any person, firm or corporation; for the
violation or infringement of any copyright,
trademark, trade name, service mark or patent; or
of any other right of any person, firm or
corporation; or
(iii) any or all claims arising out of Licensee’s failure
to comply with the provisions of these Rules and
Regulations or any other law, or Rules applicable
to Licensee.
14 | Pa ge
